column1: # Output budgets (ADR 0001 section 8.3): the named maximum number of stdout bytes of a command on a benchmark fixture.
#   HOT   read on every hook event or by a parser (next, summary --status, hook-config, report-tokens): the 0.0.40 size.
#   STEP  read once per lifecycle step (pipeline, digest, questions, the verify-* family): the 0.0.40 size per fixture state.
# Fixtures are those of tests/bench/agent-procs.mjs (small, perf, scale-0, scale-20, scale-60). The numbers are the stdout bytes of tests/bench/
# agent-procs-baseline-0.0.40.json (an error exit counts too: its stdout may not grow either); summary --status was not in that table and is
# measured by the same script on the same code (shell engine, 0.0.41 = 0.0.40 for this command). A moved command may print less, never more.
# agent-procs.mjs --compare and tests/bench/output-budgets.test.mjs fail when a command exceeds its row. Raise a row only with a decision in docs/decisions.md.
